title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E3 — School's a Drag
Mark gets in an accident with the school's drivers' education car and fears the tough, new principal, P.J. Moore, may discharge him. Sherman Hemsley and Don Cheadle guest star.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E4 — Limpin' Lizards
Nicole gets a part on the "Lester the Lizard and Crocodile Kids" show. When Mark complains about being assigned as the drivers' education teacher, PJ reassigns him to the home economics teacher position.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E5 — Free at Last
When Vanessa is not given the promotion she was promised, she takes Mark's advice to demand her rights and is promptly discharged from her job.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E6 — Father Fairest
When Earvin tells Mark that his greatest wish is to see his long-lost father, Mark locates Earvin's dad and invites him to the Halloween dance with nearly disastrous results.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E7 — The Goodbye Girl
Mark persuades Geneva to use "reverse psychology" on the rebellious Nicole, and they let her do anything she wants to teach her that rules are important. Vanessa pretends to like sports to impress a man.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E9 — Everybody Hates The New Kid
When a new student, Albert, enrolls at Corleone, Chris realizes that he has a lot more in common with Albert than just being the only two African American kids in school.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E10 — Everybody Hates Kwanzaa
With Christmas break right around the corner, Chris' holiday cheer turns to holiday blues when his teacher, Ms. Morello, assigns homework requiring each student to do a good deed over the break.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E11 — Everybody Hates The Port Authority
Chris and his family decide to take a trip down South to attend the funeral of Julius' distant relative.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E12 — Everybody Hates Earth Day
Chris must come up with a school project for Earth Day, so he decides to collect cans, believing it will be an easy task and something Julius can help him accomplish.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E13 — Everybody Hates Minimum Wage
When Doc refuses to give Chris a raise, Chris goes out and gets a new job at the local Chinese restaurant.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E14 — Everybody Hates Gretzky
In an attempt to keep his younger brother, Drew, out of further trouble, Chris reluctantly agrees to skip school and accompany Drew on a mission to find his idol, hockey great Wayne Gretzky.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E15 — Everybody Hates The BFD
Chris is so desperate to raise the funds to go to a Run DMC concert that he jumps at the chance to participate in Mr. Omar's Black Funeral Directors' (BFD) scholarship fund.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E16 — Everybody Hates Being Cool
On a mission to become one of the 'cool' kids, Chris is caught with cigarettes and suspended from school.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E19 — The Big Practice What You Preach
Using her womanly charm and baking skill, Phyllis competes with another female parishioner for the heart of the single and handsome Pastor Adams (guest star Clifton Davis), who is christening Big Dee Dee's new baby boy, Drew.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E20 — The Big Employee Benefits Episode
When Dee Dee and her law school rival vie for the same internship at a prestigious firm, Dee Dee resorts to dressing provocatively to gain a competitive edge and impress her potential new boss.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E21 — The Big Fetish What You Started Episode
When Dee Dee reluctantly rekindles a romance with her ex-boyfriend Clay (guest star Kiko Ellsworth), she wonders if he can appreciate her for more than her Jimmy Choos. Nu Soul Singer Musiq performs.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E22 — The Big Mother Of A Mother's Day Rides Again Episode
When half-sisters Dee Dee and Mona compete over who can give the best Mother’s Day gift, the special day is overshadowed by their materialistic gestures.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E23 — The Big Rules Of Engagement Episode
Despite going to great lengths to impress Nick's parents, Mona learns from Dee Dee that they don't approve of interracial relationships, but when she attempts to confront Nick about it, he stops her short with a marriage proposal.

title: Half & Half
description:
S2 E24 — The Big My Lover My Brother Episode
Dee Dee's overzealous attempts to help Mona bounce back from her recent broken engagement unintentionally drive Mona into Spencer's passionate arms. Alicia  Calaway guest stars as a trainer.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E1 — The Big My Little Pony Episode
When Mona finds out the pony Charles gave Dee Dee when they were kids is still around (who she named 'Daddy's Favorite'), Mona's childhood feelings of sibling rivalry resurface.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E2 — The Big Birth-Date Episode
When Mona and Dee Dee decide to find the perfect man for each other as birthday presents, Dee Dee quickly finds Mona’s date, James, but even with the help of Spencer and Adam, Mona struggles desperately to find a date for Dee Dee.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E3 — The Big Advice to Put It On Ice Episode
When sexual tension leads to conflict in the workplace between Spencer and Mona, Dee Dee and Adam encourage them to close the book on their romantic feelings for each other.

title: Half & Half
description:
S3 E4 — The Big One Wedding And A Funeral Episode
Mona and Dee attend a wedding of one of Dee's ex-boyfriends Neil, while Phyllis and Big Dee attend the funeral of someone they were both once intimately involved with.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E20 — A Few So-So Men
Malcolm unwittingly hires Eddie's longtime enemy to install a new bar at McGee's.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E21 — A Delicate Procedure
After agreeing to date Tim's sister, Malcolm must then find a way to break up.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E22 — Car Trouble
Eddie finds a gangster's hidden cash hidden inside Malcolm's new car.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E23 — Kansas City Split
When Malcolm falls for a spiritual guru and Eddie gets a new job offer, they agree to sell the business and move on.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E1
An aspiring radio sports announcer, Malcolm, and his talkative, would-be tow truck driver roommate, Eddie, attend a get-rich-quick seminar in hopes of winning a much-needed TV.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E2 — Eddie By Moonlight
Eddie needs another job to get his prized tow truck repaired.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E3 — On The Radio
A chance to fill in on an all-night music show has Malcolm exhausted.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E4 — Partnership Of Fools
Malcolm and Eddie use their lottery winnings to buy their building from Kelly.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E5 — Someday My TAFKAP Will Come
Eddie arranges for the Artist Formerly Known as Prince to appear at Kelly's re-opening party.
